cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your picnic rota is a useful draft. Mine has committee approval. I taught you to put the authorising body at the top, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've finally filled the food column. Mine establishes who was entitled to request those sandwiches. You skipped the heading again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll attach it as an appendix to mine. Put 'supporting rota' where I showed you; your sandwiches can come under my committee approval.
